# Rod Banks

Rod Banks is a Fayette County contact (724 area code) who appears in the iMessage corpus across a three-year window, April 2017 to July 2020 — spanning [[wiki/people/fran-coldren|Fran Coldren]]'s final caregiving years through the post-death period. The preserved sample message — "Fran's door to the room in the basement is unlocked. Please get your stuff out of Fran's house tonight!" — places Banks in a position of authority over Fran's property at [[wiki/places/117-belmont-circle|117 Belmont Circle]], speaking with a directive tone that suggests either a family role, an estate-management capacity, or a property caretaker arrangement.

The message range (2017–2020) brackets Fran's death on April 4, 2018, and extends two years past it — consistent with someone involved in the disposition of her household or estate rather than a purely social contact.

## The other half of the thread, and what it makes him

> **CORRECTED [2026-09-04] — "Direction: All received (export artifact)" was
> wrong, and the whole reading above was built on one side of a conversation.**
> This page was written from 41 messages in the CSV export and attributed their
> one-sidedness to the export. The dox-scan dump holds the same thread at **92
> messages — 51 Sent, 41 Received.** Dan's half exists. It was never missing;
> it was in a corpus this page did not cite.

The Sent half changes what he is. On the received-only reading he is a man
issuing directives about Fran's property — *"Please get your stuff out of
Fran's house tonight!"* — and the page could not say whether that was a
family, caretaker or estate role. With both halves the answer is plain, and it
is none of those three: **Rod Banks is the disbursing agent for the Coldren
estate.** He does not own the authority; he executes it.

What he does, dated:

| Date | What he does |
|---|---|
| 2017-05-23 | Authorises a title transfer — *"Yes, it is OK to have Fran transfer the title this afternoon"* |
| 2017-05-30 | *"I will be canceling Fran's Insurance."* |
| 2017-06-12 | Routes a reimbursement and checks it against a prior payment — *"I think Amy was already reimbursed for this. Vicky can show you a copy of the check."* |
| 2017-11-10 | Audits a utility notice — *"This notice is dated 5/2/17 what's up?"* |
| 2017-12-22 | *"If you turn in Timeslips through yesterday and give them to Vicki I will pay those."* |
| 2018-05 | Collects Fran's mail weekly from the house |

And Dan writes to him the way you write to somebody who controls a budget:
*"Hi rod! What is the appropriate way to be reimbursed for a dinner for gram?
She didn't have enough cash on hand when we went to th[e]..."*, then chases it
three weeks later with an offer to scan the receipt. The register is a person
applying to a process, and it is the same register the corpus records him using
with [[wiki/people/fred-adams|Judge Fred Adams]].

## The estate advances, itemised — five checks nobody had counted

**This is the find.** Between October 2019 and April 2020, Banks writes Dan a
series of checks against the undistributed Fran estate, and the thread records
each one with its amount, its date and **who authorised it**:

| Date | Amount | The authorisation, in his words |
|---|---|---|
| 2019-10-12 | **$5,000** | *"I got in touch with Jason. I will write a check payable to you for $5000."* |
| 2020-02-04 | **$10,000** | *"Yes, he contacted me yesterday. I will prepare a check for $10,000."* |
| 2020-03-06 | **$7,000** | *"Jason contacted me about a check for you. I will prepare a check for $7000."* |
| 2020-03-27 | **$3,000** | *"Jason has approved a $3000 check for you."* |
| 2020-04-17 | **$7,500** | *"Jason has authorized me to issue another check to you for $7,500."* |
| | **$32,500** | |

**The chain is two-step and both steps are named.** *Jason* — **Jason Adams**,
the estate attorney identified on [[wiki/people/fred-adams]] — approves; Rod
Banks writes. Banks says so four times in six months and never once claims the
decision. On 2020-01-10 he says it outright: *"I've been getting my information
from Jason. He says things should be wrapping up this month or next month. He
is waiting on approval of so[mething]."*

> **CONTRADICTION with [[wiki/mind/synthesis/estate-money-spine]], and it is
> not small.** That page's timeline carries one line for this period —
> *"2020-06-23 · Estate advance issued · $10,000"*. The thread here holds
> **five** advances totalling **$32,500**, none of them dated 2020-06-23, and
> the $10,000 in it is dated **2020-02-04**. Either there were two $10,000
> advances four months apart, or the spine's date belongs to one of these
> checks and drifted. **This page does not resolve it** — the spine is a
> synthesis with its own derivation and re-running it is a separate pass — but
> the spine's headline framing of the 2020 distribution as the single capital
> event now has $32,500 of dated, itemised, authorised flow in front of it that
> it does not count.

> **The payees are withheld under the standing directive in `CLAUDE.md`.** Dan
> nominates a payee for each of these checks and Banks asks each time. Naming
> them here would be a new dated line about a person that directive closes. The
> amounts, the dates and the authorisation chain are the finding and are
> complete without it.

**And a phone number is deliberately not reproduced.** On 2019-05-30 Banks
sends Jason's office line in response to *"can you send me a number for jason
please?"*. This repository is public; the number is in `raw/` and stays there.

## What this does to the Fran caregiving picture

The page above reads the 2017-04-19 message — *"Please get your stuff out of
Fran's house tonight! It does not belong there"* — as a directive of unclear
provenance. In the light of the rest of the thread it is an estate agent
clearing a property, six days before the same man is arranging Dan's direct
deposit and eleven months before Fran dies. The tone was never personal. It was
administrative, and Dan was on the receiving end of an administration he was
also inside of, which is the same double position
[[wiki/timeline/events/fran-death-vigil]] records at the bedside.

## Gaps

> **GAP CLOSED [2026-09-04] — he is the estate's disbursing agent.** This
> section read: *"Exact relationship to Fran (family member, estate
> representative, or property caretaker) is unresolved."* The Sent half of the
> thread settles it. He authorises a title transfer, cancels Fran's insurance,
> pays Timeslips, audits a utility notice, routes reimbursements against prior
> payments, and writes five estate checks totalling $32,500 on another man's
> authorisation. He is not family, not a caretaker, and not the decision-maker
> — he is the hand the estate's money passes through.

Still open: whether "Banks" connects to the Coldren/Whyel/Shrum maternal
network; his formal title, if he had one; and whether he was compensated. No
Facebook or other corpus cross-references found. **The unresolved question is
now upstream of him rather than about him** — the relationship between Jason
Adams, [[wiki/people/fred-adams|Fred Adams]] and Adams & Adams, and which of
them held what authority when, is not established anywhere in the corpus and is
answerable only from the estate docket.
